title: 弹性专家并行实现资源高效的强化学习后训练
summary: 针对MoE模型强化学习后训练中响应生成的计算瓶颈，提出FlexFloor系统，通过联合调整响应调度与活跃worker组，在保持专家计算可用性的同时渐进释放worker。相比verl基线，单位占用算力时间生成的响应token增加约65.40%，吞吐提升52.74%。
summary_en: FlexFloor addresses the response-generation bottleneck in RL post-training for MoE models by jointly adapting response scheduling and the active worker set, progressively releasing workers while preserving expert availability. It generates ~65.40% more response tokens per unit of occupied compute time and boosts throughput by 52.74% over the verl baseline.
